properties.name: The five intent-carrying constructors now search the design with the new node's own words and REFUSE a near-duplicate, naming both routes: sharpen the existing node with its id, or pass `distinct_from` to create anyway. Anthony asked for it implemented rather than captured, and sharpened it from a report into a forced choice — "there needs to be a deliberate decision of either update already existing node or if it is unique enough, create a new node." Five toolsnaps move (add_requirement/capability/component/decision/constraint gain one optional parameter); add_interface stays report-only because IdName is shared. Threshold normalises against the new node's OWN in-query score, so BM25's across-query incomparability never enters.
